proved_deliverables: Finite orbit period-map image on integral homology relations is nondiscrete
Finite orbit count m and homology-span rank r satisfy m >= r+2
Orbit homology span contains the rational Poincare dual of c1
ECH regrading does not remove J0 ambiguity for relative classes
Orbit infinitude need not survive a nondegenerate smooth approximation
prior_art: The spectral and rank mechanisms have explicit prior art, including the 2014 exposition cited as P.
scope_caveat: The connected interpretation is the substantive open question. A literal disconnected version admits a disjoint-ellipsoid example.
remaining_gap: Degenerate forms with nontorsion first Chern class on connected non-lens three-manifolds.
